messages:
oliver_newhire: hey all :wave: tiny question — i'm keeping daily ramp notes and a handful of short how-tos. where should each live in Notion? private 'My Pages' vs Team Docs > Product > Onboarding? also how do i request edit rights to the onboarding template and are templates versioned? thanks!
ivy_devex: welcome Oliver! personal notes -> 'My Pages' or create a private page in Team Docs > Onboarding > Private Ramps. Team-facing docs belong in Team Docs > Product > Onboarding and must go through the docs-review flow before becoming canonical. Templates are tracked (we use a `Version` property) but the canonical template is locked to docs owners.
nora_docs: @oliver_newhire I can provision an editable personal copy of the onboarding template. To get edit on the canonical one you'd need to be a docs maintainer. Please request via the DevEx form: https://redwood.com/devex/request (select "Notion template edit") or DM me the copy link and i'll attach a review label. If you want to propose changes, make edits in your copy and open a docs-review PR; include a brief changelog and target version.
sam_manager: naming convention we use: "Ramp — <First> <Last> (Week X)"; add a page property Visibility=private and tags like #ramp #private. When promoting to Team Docs, set Owner=<name> and change Visibility=team before filing the docs PR. If you'd like weekly check-ins, share the page with me (Viewer or Commenter).
notion_bot: System: Notion access invite queued for template copy. SSO/SCIM sync expected within ~15 minutes.
oliver_newhire: perfect — i'll make a private copy, title it "Ramp — Oliver W (Week 1)", and request the DevEx form for the template copy. thanks everyone :raised_hands:
